## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T16:54Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Re-read on `main` `b393152f73`:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` `ScopeBadge` (`:188`–`:198`) still draws a scope-less row as `engine.packages.scope.writable`. PR #12722 (#12675) merged at 2026-10-16T16:38Z and left this column alone, as the card says.
- **Why p2:** an admin is told they can author into a package the server refuses to write (`writable: false` on the row).
- **For the claimant:** read the served `writable`. If objectstack#23972 (`source`, p1 + `target:v18`) lands first, read the declared field rather than inferring it.

Claim: PM loop round 5 (`priority:p2`; triage grade `6220454140`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12723-packages-writable-badge`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12723` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: Setup → Packages' Scope badge, in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`:
- `PackagesPage.tsx`: `ScopeBadge` (`:188`) and its two call sites (`:716`, `:1375`), so the writable / read-only half reads the served row's `writable` verdict and the system / cloud / project half keeps `scope`;
- `i18n.ts`: a read-only label in the designer's own string table (en and zh) only if no existing key says it;
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12723-*.md`.

Outside the surface: the Source column and `packageSource.ts` (objectui#12675, landed), the page header, the marketplace row actions, and any objectstack change. objectstack-ai/objectstack#23972 (the declared `source` key, in flight) is not waited on: `writable` is already served and pinned (objectstack#14375).

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: the badge stops contradicting a verdict the server already serves. No published key, export or accept set changes, and a designer string-table key is not a published pack key.
Responsibility: n/a — `ScopeBadge`'s scope-less-means-writable rule predates the marketplace install path; no landed PR is named as its cause
Thread-read: 6220454140
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `c9e6742`. objectui#12675's PR #12722 (the same file, list body) merged as `9d857c998c`. No open PR names `PackagesPage.tsx` or `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (every open PR's file list was read). objectui#12733 (`pm:blocked`) waits on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23933 and is not in flight.
